title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
abstract: arXiv:2602.10657v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How much of zero-shot benchmark accuracy is captured by word-level alignment between a pre-training corpus and the benchmark target? We study this question through word-level unigram cross-entropy (UCE), a tokenizer-agnostic, model-free measure of lexical alignment between a reference corpus and a target benchmark. Likelihood training shapes the model's predictive distribution from the pre-training corpus, and zero-shot scores under likelihood-based evaluation depend in part on the lexical alignment between that corpus and the benchmark target. Cleanly tracing how the lexical imprint of pre-training data scales with corpus--benchmark alignment requires controlled from-scratch pre-training that varies corpus identity while holding the training recipe fixed. translated_title: 预训练数据的词汇印记
translated_abstract: 预训练语料库与基准测试目标之间的词级对齐，能在多大程度上解释零样本基准测试的准确率？我们通过词级一元交叉熵来研究这个问题。这是一种与分词器无关、无需模型参与的度量方法，用于衡量参考语料库与目标基准之间的词汇对齐程度。似然训练基于预训练语料库来塑造模型的预测分布，而在基于似然的评估中，零样本得分部分取决于该语料库与基准目标之间的词汇对齐。要清晰地追踪预训练数据的词汇印记如何随语料库与基准的对齐程度而变化，需要进行受控的从零预训练实验，即在保持训练方案固定不变的情况下，改变所使用的语料库。在这一受控扫描实验中，我们涵盖了10个零样本基准、4个预训练语料库和3个模型规模，发现语料库与基准之间的词汇对齐程度（即UCE）始终……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出词级一元交叉熵（UCE）这一与分词器无关、无需模型的词汇对齐度量，并通过受控的从零预训练实验证明，预训练语料库与基准测试之间的词汇对齐程度能够持续解释零样本基准准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces word-level unigram cross-entropy (UCE), a tokenizer-agnostic and model-free measure of lexical alignment, and shows through controlled from-scratch pre-training across 10 benchmarks, 4 corpora, and 3 model scales that corpus–benchmark lexical alignment consistently predicts zero-shot benchmark accuracy.
